rounds.clue: A tall man in a green coat walks into a department store and announces that he is an elf.
A boy in pajamas stands on a train that serves hot chocolate as the world outside turns to snow.
A green figure squeezes down a chimney and stuffs a whole tree up the flue.
A department-store Santa insists, very calmly, that he is the real one.
A man stands on a snowy bridge and wishes he had never been born. An angel shows up.
The other reindeer laugh until a glowing nose saves Christmas Eve.
A tiny tree, a blanket, and a kid who learns the pageant is enough.
A dad falls off a roof in a red suit and wakes up with a job he did not apply for.
Santa’s youngest son takes a high-tech sleigh because the official one is running late.
A woodsman and a little girl build toys so a town will believe again. Almost no one speaks.
